propositional-logic-1.officialAnswer: It is a [proposition](ref:proposition): the declarative statement has a definite [truth value](ref:truth-value). It is true because $7+5=12$.

graph-theory-21.prompt: Which descriptions apply to $a,b,c,d,e$: walk, [trail](ref:trail), [path](ref:path), or [cycle](ref:cycle)? Give every applicable description and the length, and justify your classifications.

linear-algebra-projections-51.officialAnswer: With $A=(1,2)^T$ and coefficient $x=1$, the output is $Ax=(1,2)^T=b$. The residual is $b-Ax=(0,0)^T$, whose dot product with $(1,2)^T$ is $0$. The squared error is $0$, the smallest possible value, so this is a least-squares solution.

linear-algebra-eigenvalues-23.officialAnswer: The only eigenvalue is $1$, with algebraic multiplicity two because the characteristic polynomial is $(1-\lambda)^2$. Since $A$ is the identity matrix, its eigenspace for $1$ is all of $\mathbb R^2$, of dimension two. A basis of eigenvectors exists, so $A$ is diagonalizable.
